verdict.rationale: The only evidence is that Conta Simples' API can link receipts and invoices to existing transactions, download the linked files, and reconcile transactions. This shows the platform attaches receipts to transactions, but only through a server-to-server API where the caller already knows the target transaction. missing for 10: employee photo capture (mobile/app), email-forwarding inbox for receipts, OCR extraction of receipt data, automatic matching of receipts to the correct transaction, independent or hands-on corroboration.
